name: 500-AI-Agents-Projects
summary: Curated collection of AI agent use cases across industries with links to open-source implementations.
relevance: Idea-sourcing when scoping a new agent project.

name: CloakBrowser
summary: Stealth Chromium that passes bot detection tests; drop-in Playwright replacement with source-level fingerprint patches.
relevance: Directly useful for scraping/automation work our Playwright e2e suites don't already cover.

name: AiSOC
summary: Open-source AI-powered Security Operations Center: alert fusion, purple-team drills, agent-assisted triage, MITRE ATT&CK investigation.
relevance: Reference if we ever build or evaluate security monitoring tooling.

name: ai-engineering-from-scratch
summary: Hands-on tutorials for building AI agents from scratch: LLM APIs, prompt engineering, tool calling, the agent loop.

name: archify
summary: Agent skill for architecture, workflow, sequence, data-flow, and lifecycle diagrams as self-contained, verifiable HTML.
relevance: Candidate to actually install as a skill under ~/.claude/skills.

name: Keycloak
summary: Mature, enterprise-grade open-source identity and access management for modern applications and services.
relevance: Heavyweight self-hosted IAM option if a project ever needs full SSO/SAML beyond Supabase Auth.

name: Logto
summary: Authentication and authorization infrastructure for SaaS and AI apps, built on OIDC and OAuth 2.1 with multi-tenancy, SSO, and RBAC.
relevance: Directly relevant to Shift Tasks' multi-provider auth generalization work — lighter-weight than Keycloak, same TypeScript stack.

name: site-teardown
summary: Reverse-engineers a website's HTML/JS/CSS into a tech-stack, design-system, effects, and build-blueprint document.
relevance: Installed at ~/.claude/skills/site-teardown for competitive research before building.

name: funnel-spy
summary: Walks a competitor's whole sales funnel into a scored, sourced teardown dossier: pages, offer ladder, ad signals, tracking pixels.
relevance: Installed at ~/.claude/skills/funnel-spy for competitive research before building.
